name: Rounding Parameters 1
definition: Parameters applied to a fractional number.

RoundingModulus.name: Rounding Modulus
RoundingModulus.definition: Float value specifying the value to which rounding is required, eg, 10 means round to a multiple of 10 units/shares, 0.5 means round to a multiple of 0.5 units/shares.

RoundingDirection.name: Rounding Direction
RoundingDirection.definition: Rounding direction applied to fractional numbers, eg, round up.
